scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed the required opening and/or closing branding script.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent did not address the customer by name.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy to customer's frustration.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent deflected responsibility or blamed another team instead of owning the issue.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent used rude or condescending language.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent did not ask diagnostic questions to investigate the problem.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Before closing, ask the customer to confirm the issue is fixed and state clearly that it is resolved.

grader.graded_by: Claude (written and graded before any model run; not human-reviewed)
grader.notes: Very poor call with long managed holds (so H and V still pass). B: no scripts. PE: no name. E: distressed customer ignored. R: "I'm not a miracle worker." PA: no restatement. AL: re-asks the account holder and the date the service stopped. O: "That's the billing team's mess, not mine, ring them back tomorrow." PR: no questions about the problem. CR: nothing resolved.
